structured_checks.checks: The post-state scripts.ini machine Startup section carries exactly the parameterized entries from args.startup_cmd (script, parameters, authored order, no extras). Beyond the bounded evaluator: list-valued comparison implemented in the assertion layer.
The psscripts.ini machine Startup section carries exactly the entries from args.startup_ps1.

The psscripts config shape records the ps_order setting: powershell_first maps to the StartExecutePSFirst/EndExecutePSFirst keys, default to their absence — whichever shape Windows actually writes is itself an R2 answer, so this check asserts the recorded value equals the authored intent after normalization, not a pre-chosen key name.
Every relative path in post.scope.sysvol_relpaths stays under this GPO's GUID directory. Backs the sysvol_contained fact the declarative forbid consumes; computed by the observer, asserted here.

bindings.args: Capability arguments are bound into predicates under the `args` namespace; the runtime flattens the parameter tree into dotted-index keys (args['startup_cmd.0.script']). The envelope engine itself is namespace-agnostic; merging args is transaction-executor work.
bindings.fact_vocabulary: Fact keys reference gpo_observers' declared scheme (gpo_identity.*, ad.*, version.*, scripts_ini.*, sysvol.*, scope.*). Forbid clauses receive `scope` bound to the named fact's value and `scope_key` to its name, per wcd.envelope._build_bindings.
